newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Astra says to list three units.
newsitem.headline: Astra says to list three units.

text.p: Indonesia's largest automobile maker PT Astra International said on Tuesday it planned to locally list three subsidiaries either this year or in 1998.
Astra finance director Rini Suwandi told reporters that Bank Universal and PT Astra Dian Lestari from its automotive components division were expected to be listed this year.
She said a subsidiary in the agribusiness division, which she declined to identify, could be listed this year or in 1998.
"Bank Universal and PT Astra Dian Lestari have the bigger chance of being listed this year," she told reporters after attending a conference organised by PT ING Baring Securities.
"The agribusiness firm might be listed this year or in 1998," she said, declining to give further details.
